title: n8n Schedule Trigger fires hours off from the intended local time in Docker
symptoms: Schedule set for 9:00 runs at 6:00 or 15:00 local time
Cron expression correct but execution times shifted by a fixed offset
Times look right only for US Eastern users
cause: GENERIC_TIMEZONE defaults to America/New_York, and schedule nodes use it rather than the host or container clock.
fix: Set GENERIC_TIMEZONE (and TZ for the container) to your zone, or set the workflow timezone in workflow settings.
